name: Amazon Prime Store Card

apr.notes: APR not visible on fetched pages. Amazon product page returned garbled content; Synchrony servicing page did not display rates.

base_rate.description: Prime Store Card members with an eligible Prime membership earn 5% back (rewards points equal to 5% of the purchase) at Amazon.com and Whole Foods Market. As a closed-loop store card, spending is limited to Amazon and Whole Foods.

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards points (5% back) can be redeemed toward eligible Amazon.com purchases. Non-Prime cardholders receive special financing offers instead of 5% back.

notes: Closed-loop private-label store card issued by Synchrony Bank; it does not run on a major payment network, so network is 'other' and network_tier is 'none' (previous mastercard/world was incorrect). Verified via Amazon and Synchrony official pages: eligible Prime members earn 5% back (rewards points equal to 5% of purchase) at Amazon.com and Whole Foods Market with the Prime Store Card; non-Prime cardholders receive special financing instead. APR not published on the product page. Bonus category rates pending re-verification against the official page.
